explication: Nunchaku is a GPU inference engine for quantized neural networks, particularly image-generation models. A typical user-facing workflow is to launch a model-specific demo, run inference through a Nunchaku transformer, and receive generated images; the repository also provides LoRA conversion, caching, and PuLID personalization. The native C++/CUDA engine and Python model layers implement the inference core. Edges are limited to relationships shown in excerpts, the source index, or README statements; several listed model and demo files were not sampled, so their internal wiring is not inferred.
